summary: Frontend-only test of the compact/expand shortcuts toggle (iter7 UX enhancement). All 9 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end via Playwright on both desktop (1920x900) and mobile (412x915) viewports. Toggle button present, label switches (COMPRIMI ↔ ESPANDI), localStorage key 'ai4life_shortcuts_collapsed_v1' persists ('true'/'false'), default mobile=compact / desktop=expanded, chip icons remain fully functional in compact mode (style-cyberpunk toggles active, recipe-code-review fills prompt input), title tooltip preserved, no layout breakage, gradient backdrop intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx line 51: matchMedia default evaluated inside useState initializer — Playwright confirms this DOES work with the pod's viewport being applied before React mounts on reload (mobile default correctly = compact). Non-blocking; the persisted localStorage value dominates on subsequent visits.

RecipesStrip.jsx & StylePresets.jsx: In compact mode chip text is hidden via conditional {!compact && r.label}, but the flex `gap-1.5` still applies. Visually clean in screenshots — no orphan whitespace. OK.
Consider adding aria-pressed / aria-expanded on toggle-shortcuts-btn for a11y (currently only has title). Minor enhancement, not a blocker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 UX toggle fully verified. Data-testids in use: toggle-shortcuts-btn, recipes-strip, style-presets, recipe-<id> (recipe-code-review, recipe-analyze-contract, recipe-summarize-paper, recipe-cyberpunk-moodboard, recipe-translate-professional, recipe-brainstorm-ideas, recipe-luxury-product-shot, recipe-meeting-minutes), style-<id> (photorealistic, flat, cyberpunk, watercolor, isometric, luxury). localStorage key: ai4life_shortcuts_collapsed_v1. No regressions observed in PromptDock / Compare button / sessions sidebar.

detailed_verifications.persistence_reload: PASS — after reload, button still 'ESPANDI', localStorage still 'true', chips still icon-only.
